observations: Two car headlights are shown on a tiled floor.
The lenses are clear and appear to be in good cosmetic condition.
The housing and mounting brackets are visible.
There is a watermark 'UKS ENTERPRISES' across the center of the image.
No brand names, logos, or model numbers are legible on the headlights.

claims.evidence: The item is shown, but the brand and model are not readable to confirm origin.

risks.risk: The headlights may be for a different car model than the buyer's.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's label or the part number stamped on the housing.
risks.if_unproven: as a generic replacement part for an unknown model

risks.risk: The internal bulb sockets or wiring may be damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the headlights showing the sockets and wiring.

risks.risk: The lenses may have internal scratches or haze that cannot be seen from the front.
risks.proof: A photo of the lenses with a bright light source shining through them.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's label or part number on the back of the headlights.
Photo of the back of the headlights to check the sockets and wiring.
Photo of the lenses with a light shining through to check for internal scratches.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
